text: {"lessons":["Prices have moved up and down unpredictably, so I should not assume a recent gain or loss will continue.","My account value has fluctuated despite mostly holding, reminding me that short-term changes are normal and do not by themselves require a trade.","Selling some Stock A after a large gain converted part of that gain to cash; future trades should fit my goals and risk tolerance, not just the average cost or recent price move."]}
